summary: Scales into a dominant split-pusher. Early he relies on Counter Strike (E) to win trades; trade when it's on cooldown and slow his attack speed to deny his on-hit scaling.
threats: E (Counter Strike) dodges autos for about 2s, reduces AoE damage, then stuns.
Q (Leap Strike) gap-closes onto you, minions, or wards.
R (Grandmaster's Might) at level 5 gives armor/MR and extra on-hit damage.
Gets stronger with every item and wants a long game.

matchups.why: Jax's damage is mostly physical autos, which Malphite's armor and E attack-speed slow hard-counter. Q poke and speed steal let Malphite dictate trades.
trading: Q (Seismic Shard) poke when he walks up.
E (Ground Slam) as soon as he jumps in to slow his attack speed.
Don't auto into his active Counter Strike; wait it out.
matchups.early: Poke with Q and farm. He can't trade well into your shield and armor.
matchups.spike: At 5, R plus jungler makes him an easy kill target.
matchups.wave: Let him push and farm safely; build armor.
matchups.jungle: Your R sets up the gank; call once his E is down.
matchups.build: Grasp of the Undying. Early armor items and armor boots.
matchups.remember: Armor up and slow his attacks.

matchups.why: Counter Strike only reduces Garen's E spin (it's AoE, not an auto), and Q's silence stops Jax casting E at all. Garen wins short early trades; Jax wins once he has items and R.
trading: Q (Decisive Strike) him before he presses E. A silenced Jax can't Counter Strike.
If he's already in Counter Strike, don't Q into it. Walk out of the stun radius and wait ~2s.
After it ends, Q + E spin and walk away before he gets a second rotation.
Avoid long fights from level 5 on; his R armor/MR plus on-hit outscales your spin.
matchups.early: Levels 1–3 favor you on short trades. Look for Q trades when he steps up to last-hit.
matchups.spike: Your R executes if he's low, but his R makes him far tankier. Don't commit to an all-in unless the execute math is there.
matchups.wave: Slow-push while you're winning trades; freeze if he gets ahead so he must walk to you.
matchups.jungle: He escapes with Q (Leap Strike) onto wards or minions. Gank after he's used it.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Armor boots against his autos.
matchups.remember: Silence the Counter Strike, then walk.

matchups.why: Both are cooldown duelists: Riposte parries Jax's Counter Strike stun, and vitals' true damage ignores his R resists. But Counter Strike dodges her autos. Whoever wastes their parry first loses.
trading: Hold W (Riposte) until his Counter Strike stun goes off, then parry it and stun him back.
While his E is active, Lunge away; don't auto into the dodge window.
Once his E is down and your W is up, commit with vitals for an extended trade.
matchups.early: Even. Track his E and your W cooldowns and only fight when yours is up and his isn't.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R heal zone wins extended fights, as long as he doesn't stun you through it.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and fight in cooldown windows; don't fight inside his full wave.
matchups.jungle: He's gankable after Q, his only escape.

matchups.why: Tryndamere's damage is almost all autos, and Counter Strike dodges every one while charging the stun. Jax wins every trade where E is up, and his R resists blunt Tryndamere's crits later.
trading: When he presses E, walk away. Never auto into Counter Strike.
Use W (Mocking Shout) to slow him if he chases after the stun.
Trade only in the window after his E ends; that's ~10s of free autos.
Use Q (Bloodlust) to heal off trades you lose instead of staying in.
matchups.early: Play safe and farm. Your Fury needs time; don't take trades when his E is up.
matchups.spike: Your R stops you dying, but Jax's R plus E still out-trades you. Use R to escape, not to all-in.
matchups.wave: Farm under tower and split-push later; avoid long trades in lane.
matchups.jungle: Ask for a gank when his E and Q are both down.
matchups.build: Lethal Tempo or Conqueror. Crit and attack speed; armor boots if behind.
matchups.remember: Wait out Counter Strike, then go.
